name: pounce
desc:
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
If the target is prone, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.
